balances.matchedExplanation: The submitted regimen transition satisfies the reviewed broad initial-medication route.
balances.unmatchedExplanation: The submitted regimen transition does not satisfy the reviewed broad initial-medication route.
balances.rationale: The +200 value is provisional PsychSim balance from the approved dominant-primary-route band. CANMAT supports the qualitative option set but did not supply this game-point magnitude.

notTriggered.explanation: No medication was started, so this treatment-triggered medication-reconciliation prerequisite did not apply.

fulfilled.explanation: The medication list was reconciled before a medication was started.

omitted.explanation: A medication was started without reconciling the medication list.
